summary: Evidence counters and finding-to-evidence linkage (R6-T1). Newly collected session evidence now writes typed evidence IDs back onto the finding records themselves (not just graph edges), and every collection run records attempted-vs-persisted evidence counts. Evidence-save failures — previously only visible in the console — are now counted and surfaced through the mission evidence-integrity endpoint. Historical findings without linkage continue to load unchanged.
what_was_done: Findings now carry an evidenceIds array on the record itself. When the evidence graph links a finding to evidence at finalize time, those evidence IDs are mirrored onto the findings-store record (idempotent — re-running collection never duplicates links; only IDs the graph itself resolves are written)

Every session finalize stamps evidenceStats on the mission: attempted vs persisted evidence counts, observations, links, evidenceIds written back, with a timestamp and the save-health snapshot at stamp time

Evidence-graph save failures are now counted with the last error and timestamp, exposed as evidenceSaveHealth on the mission evidence-integrity diagnostics endpoint (explicit nulls when never failed — nothing fabricated)
The evidence-integrity endpoint additionally reports a linkage block: how many of the mission's findings have typed evidence linked vs not
Historical findings that predate linkage load with an empty evidenceIds array (normalized on load), so no consumer needs a special case
The scope guard from the R6 spec held: no screenshot artifact persistence, no retention policy, no shell cleanup, no database work
what_was_tested: New finding receives the correct evidence IDs; unrelated evidence is not linked (asserted)
Idempotency: repeated collection does not duplicate links
Historical findings without evidenceIds normalize to empty array and load safely
Counters accurate in success path; simulated persistence failure (unwritable data dir) is visible in save health with no silent loss
Integrity endpoint surfaces counters, save health, and linkage counts; F4 ownership still enforced on the modified route

F1–F5 regression battery re-run at the T1 commit: all green (BrowserStack validation, browser ownership, interrupted reason, frame recovery, lifecycle, awaiting-input, resource-lifecycle, session-timeout, runtime-kick)
